comment: Item 1 of the dispositiv only reclassifies the Eingabe as subsidiaere Verfassungsbeschwerde; item 2 says nicht eingetreten -> inadmissible. Extended four i.V.m. chains; amount Fr. 50 Mio. was cut to Fr. 50 (extended); added one BGE list item.
